audit.whatIsWrong: QA lint pass: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, dontsFull[2].d carried MISGENDER / COPY_PASTE_BLEED / COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT / UNSUPPORTED_MAGNITUDE findings.
audit.why: matchup-lint.js flagged these classes; QA pass owns them.
audit.corrected: Pronouns corrected to enemy gender; duplicated dos/donts rephrased; kit cooldown digits added (Malzahar R 140s, Viktor W 17s, Neeko E 12s); Mimic magnitude claim replaced with its mechanic.

edits.before: - Viktor Gravity Field: matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Viktor Gravity Field (17s rank 1): matchup-defining — The stun zone owns every all-in — walk out the moment it drops or fight outside it. Check it before every step-up. - W Gravity Field is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Lead E through the wave into his chest, absorb the reply on your Q shield, take the empowered auto, and walk out ahead.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Don’t cast E at melee-adjacent range once his engage is loaded — your own long cast windups are what he punishes.
